title: 第28章 是谁赢麻了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 旁边围观的人群里，立刻响起窸窸窣窣的笑声。“我就说嘛，垃圾堆里能捡到什么好东西？”“还建窑呢，连基本常识都没有。”陈静更是笑出了声，故意抬高音量：“哎呀，温栩栩，你是不是连百度都没查过？建窑以茶盏闻名，哪有你这么大的咸菜罐？翻车了吧？”温栩栩没理她。她盯着屏幕里老人的表情，总觉得哪里不对劲——如果真是假的，老爷子应该直接说“假的”才对，这反应怎么像是在犹豫？她脑子里忽然闪过一个念头。“爷爷，您等一下。”温栩栩从包里又翻出一张湿巾，往罐子底部用力擦了擦。刚才只擦了泥垢，现在她连边边角角都仔细蹭了一遍。当湿巾抹过底部最边缘的位置时，一行若隐若现的刻痕露了出来。司凛配合地把镜头怼过去。老人原本漫不经心的表情，在看清那行刻痕的瞬间，整个人像被雷劈中一样定住了。他猛地抓起放大镜，脸几乎贴到屏幕上，呼吸都变得急促起来：“这……这是……”旁边的笑声还在继续，陈静甚至开始跟旁边的人挤眉弄眼。但老人的下一句话，让所有声音戛然而止：“这是宋代宫廷定制的铭文……‘供奉内府’……这种带铭文的建窑大罐，存世不超过三件！！”他激动得声音都在发抖：“这不是普通建窑！这是建窑里的极品！是专门烧给皇家的贡品！”全场安静得能听见针掉在地上的声音。陈静的笑容凝固在脸上，怀疑自已的耳朵。老人还在屏幕那头手舞足蹈，激动得胡子都在抖：“小凛！这罐子谁家的？！卖不卖？！”司凛看了温栩栩一眼：“温栩栩的。”老人眼睛瞬间亮了，像饿了三天的人看见满汉全席：“丫头！把罐子举高一点！底部铭文对准！对！再近一点！慢点慢点——”温栩栩被他这架势震住了，乖乖配合。镜头对准罐底那几行模糊的字迹。老爷子把脸凑到屏幕前，眼睛眯成一条缝，盯着看了整整三分钟。周围安静得能听见针掉在地上的声音。然后，他缓缓摘下老花镜，抬起头，眼眶竟然有点红。声音都在抖：“这行铭文……《宋代陶瓷录》里没有记载过。”他深吸一口气：“如果我没看错，这应该是目前发现的、唯一一件带有‘供奉内府’铭文的建窑大罐。”他盯着温栩栩，一字一句：“丫头，你知道这意味着什么吗？”温栩栩愣愣地摇头。老爷子一拍大腿：“意味着它可能会弥补宋代陶瓷史的空白！”周围传来一阵倒吸冷气的声音。弥补历史空白？刚才笑温栩栩“捡破烂”的那几个人，脸上的表情像被人扇了十巴掌。陈静站在人群里，手里的奶茶杯已经彻底捏扁了，奶茶顺着指缝往下滴，她都没察觉。老爷子平复了一下情绪，清了清嗓子：“丫头，你这罐子要是放市面上，可能也就拍个一百二十万。”他顿了顿，伸出三根手指：“我出三百万。”周围炸了。“三百万？！刚才不还说一百二十万吗？！”“老爷子疯了吧？多出一百八十万？！”“你懂什么，人家要的是学术价值！”老爷子认真地看着温栩栩：“丫头，我要用这个罐子写一篇论文——关于‘供奉内府’铭文的新发现，投给《文物月刊》。”“论文里，我会专门列一个致谢部分：特别感谢温栩栩女士的发现与贡献。”温栩栩愣住了。司凛在旁边淡淡补了一句：“那本刊物，业内顶刊。”老爷子的眼睛还在发亮：“而且，三个月后，有个面向全球的龙国古代陶瓷艺术展。这个罐子会被送去参展，作为最重要的展品之一。”“到时候，你作为发现者，会收到主办方的特邀嘉宾邀请函。”周围彻底安静了。三百万。顶刊论文致谢。国际大展特邀嘉宾。这三个东西加在一起，比什么奖学金、什么荣誉都值钱。有人小声嘀咕：“她以后还愁什么啊？名字挂在司老爷子论文里，毕业直接起飞……”“何止毕业，以后去哪个博物馆、研究所，这张名片一亮，谁不得高看一眼？”“我酸了……我真的酸了……”温栩栩抱着罐子，终于没忍住，嘴角弯了弯。她低头看了一眼屏幕那头满脸期待的老爷子，又看了一眼旁边面无表情但眼底带着点笑意的司凛。然后点点头：“卖。”“谢谢爷爷赏识。”老爷子在屏幕那头乐得像个孩子：“好好好！明天就让小凛带你来我家！爷爷给你转账！”陈静站在原地，脸色青了又白，白了又青。三百万。改写陶瓷史。顶刊论文致谢。国际大展特邀嘉宾。这些词在她脑子里转来转去，像一把把刀子在剜她的心。那个她特意让保洁从废品站清出来的破烂，那个她亲手扔到温栩栩床上的垃圾——居然值三百万？！居然能改写历史？！居然能让温栩栩那个穷鬼名利双收？！她猛地抬起头，疯了一样冲向车边：“等等！！！”她一把扒住车门，声音都劈了：“这个罐子是我的！是我发现的！是我从老家带出来的！”她死死盯着温栩栩怀里的罐子，眼睛都红了：“老爷子！那是我的罐子！我的三百万！还给我！！”周围的人群瞬间炸了。“卧槽，这也行？刚才不是她说是垃圾吗？”“现在知道值钱了就说是自已的？脸呢？”“陈静这也太不要脸了吧……”温栩栩坐在车里，不慌不忙地掏出手机。点开录音，外放。陈静的声音从手机里传出来，清晰得每一个字都在打脸：“这些都是我不要的破烂！垃圾！懂吗？”“本来就是为了膈应你，专门捡回来放你床上的。”“行啊，你想要？拿去呗，全拿走，省得我倒垃圾。”
content_en: The crowd of people watching immediately burst into laughter."I'm just telling you, what good things can be found in the garbage?" "You're still building a kiln, and you don't even have basic common sense." Chen Jing laughed out loud and deliberately raised her voice: "Oh, Wen Xuxu, didn't you even check Baidu? Jianyao is famous for its tea cups. How can there be a pickle jar as big as yours? Did it overturn?" Wen Xuxu ignored her.She stared at the old man's expression on the screen, and she always felt that something was wrong - if it was true or false, the old man should just say "fake". Why did this reaction look like hesitation?A thought suddenly flashed through her mind."Grandpa, please wait a moment." Wen Xuxu took out another wet wipe from the bag and wiped the bottom of the jar vigorously.Just now she only wiped off the dirt, but now she even rubbed the corners carefully.When the wet wipe wiped the edge of the bottom, a line of faint scratches was revealed.Si Lin turned the camera away in cooperation.The old man's originally careless expression froze as if he had been struck by lightning the moment he saw the lines of carvings clearly.He suddenly grabbed the magnifying glass, his face almost touching the screen, and his breathing became rapid: "This... this is..." The laughter next to her continued, and Chen Jing even started to wink at the people next to her.But the old man's next sentence made all the voices stop abruptly: "This is an inscription customized by the Song Dynasty palace...'for the inner palace'... There are no more than three large kiln jars with this inscription in existence!!" He was so excited that his voice was trembling: "This is not an ordinary kiln! This is the best of the kiln! It is specially burned as a tribute to the royal family!" The whole place was so quiet that you could hear the sound of a needle dropping to the ground.Chen Jing's smile froze on her face, doubting her ears.The old man was still dancing on the other side of the screen, his beard trembling with excitement: "Xiao Lin! Who owns this jar?! Do you want to sell it?!" Si Lin glanced at Wen Xuxu: "It belongs to Wen Xuxu." The old man's eyes lit up instantly, like a man who had been hungry for three days when he saw a full banquet: "Girl! Lift the jar higher! Aim at the inscription on the bottom! Yes! Come closer! Slow down, slow down -" Wen Xuxu was shocked by his gesture and cooperated obediently.The camera focused on the few lines of blurry writing on the bottom of the can.The old man put his face in front of the screen, narrowed his eyes and stared at it for three full minutes.It was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.Then, he slowly took off his reading glasses, raised his head, and his eyes turned a little red.His voice was shaking: "This line of inscription... has not been recorded in the "Ceramics of the Song Dynasty"." He took a deep breath and said: "If I am not mistaken, this should be the only large kiln jar with the inscription 'for the inner palace' found so far." He stared at Wen Xuxu and said word by word: "Girl, do you know what this means?" Wen Xuxu shook his head blankly.The old man slapped his thigh: "It means it may fill the gaps in the history of ceramics in the Song Dynasty!" There was a gasp of air from around him.Fill a historical gap?The expressions on the faces of those people who just laughed at Wen Xuxu for "picking up rags" looked like they had been slapped ten times.Chen Jing stood in the crowd, the milk tea cup in her hand had been completely crushed, and the milk tea dripped down her fingers without her noticing.The old man calmed down and cleared his throat: "Girl, if this jar of yours is put on the market, it might only fetch 1.2 million." He paused and stretched out three fingers: "I'll pay 3 million." The surrounding area exploded."Three million?! Didn't you say 1.2 million just now?!" "Is the old man crazy? 1.8 million more?!" "What do you know? What they want is academic value!" The old man looked at Wen Xuxu seriously: "Girl, I want to use thisWrite a paper on a jar - about the new discovery of the "Enshrined Palace" inscription, and submit it to "Cultural Relics Monthly"."In the paper, I will include a special acknowledgment section: special thanks to Ms. Wen Xuxu for her discovery and contribution."Wen Xuxu was stunned.Si Lin added lightly next to him: "That publication is the top publication in the industry." The old man's eyes were still shining: "Moreover, in three months, there will be a global Dragon Kingdom ancient ceramic art exhibition. This jar will be sent to the exhibition as one of the most important exhibits." "At that time, as the discoverer, you will receive a special guest invitation from the organizer." The surroundings were completely quiet.Three million.Acknowledgments to the top paper.Special guest at international exhibitions.These three things together are more valuable than any scholarship or honor.Someone whispered: "What will she worry about in the future? Her name will be in Mr. Si's thesis, and she will take off immediately after graduation..." "Not only graduation, which museum or research institute will I go to in the future? Who can't take a high look at this business card?" "I'm sour... I'm really sour..." Wen Xuxu hugged the jar, and finally couldn't hold it back, and the corners of her mouth curved.She lowered her head and glanced at the expectant old man on the other side of the screen, and then at Si Lin next to her who was expressionless but with a little smile in her eyes.Then he nodded: "Sell." "Thank you, grandpa, for your appreciation." The old man on the other side of the screen was as happy as a child: "Okay, okay! Let Xiao Lin take you to my house tomorrow! Grandpa will transfer the money to you!" Chen Jing stood there, her face turning blue and white, and white and blue again.Three million.Rewriting the history of ceramics.Acknowledgments to the top paper.Special guest at international exhibitions.These words were spinning around in her mind, like knives piercing her heart.The rags that she specifically asked the cleaning staff to clear out from the scrap yard, and the garbage that she threw on Wen Xuxu's bed with her own hands - was actually worth three million?!Can you actually rewrite history?!How could he actually make that poor guy Wen Xuxu gain both fame and fortune?!She raised her head suddenly and rushed to the car like crazy: "Wait!!!" She grabbed the car door and her voice broke: "This jar is mine! I found it! I brought it from my hometown!" She stared at the jar in Wen Xuxu's arms, her eyes turned red: "Old man! That's my jar! My three million! Give it back to me!!" The crowd around them exploded instantly."Damn it, this is okay? Didn't she just say it was rubbish?" "Now that you know it's valuable, you say it's yours? Where's your face?" "Chen Jing is so shameless..." Wen Xuxu sat in the car and calmly took out her mobile phone.Click on the recording and play it externally.Chen Jing's voice came out from the mobile phone, so clear that every word was a slap in the face: "These are rags that I don't want! Trash! Do you understand?" "I picked them up and put them on your bed just to spite you." "Okay, you want them? Take them, take them all, so that I don't have to take out the trash."
